en.title: Architecture Night-Day Explorer
en.headline: Temple of Heaven
en.introText: Five landmarks. A journey from night to day.
en.smallCopy: Look closer at every roof, beam and marble terrace.
en.sceneAria: Interactive 3D architecture. Drag to rotate the selected building, scroll to zoom.
en.note: Drag the model to find your own perspective.
en.travelHint: Move the slider to change the atmosphere
en.hint: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Right-drag to pan
en.hintTouch: Drag to rotate · Use + and − to zoom
en.credit: Architecture code: MiniMax M3.1 Flash via SandBase
en.webglMissing: This scene needs WebGL. Turn on hardware acceleration or try another browser.
en.prayer.name: Hall of Prayer
en.prayer.text: Three sweeping roofs, interlocking brackets and a crown of gold. Explore the layers of the park's central landmark.
en.prayer.detail: Glazed tiles · gilded cornices · painted brackets
en.imperial-hall.name: Huangqian Hall
en.imperial-hall.text: A layered blue roof rises above vermilion columns. The close view reveals the rhythm of its painted timber frame.
en.imperial-hall.detail: Roof ridges · vermilion columns · decorative beams
en.vault.name: Imperial Vault
en.vault.text: A compact circular sanctuary, framed by a curved enclosure. Light travels across its blue tiles and painted eaves.
en.vault.detail: Circular roof · painted cornice · gold finial
en.altar.name: Circular Mound Altar
en.altar.text: Three marble terraces form a precise circular composition. Raking daylight brings the carved balustrades into relief.
en.altar.detail: Stone carvings · radial steps · concentric terraces
en.abstinence.name: Hall of Abstinence
en.abstinence.text: Green roof tiles and sheltered courtyards offer a quieter architectural rhythm at the edge of the ceremonial axis.
en.abstinence.detail: Green roof tiles · timber colonnades · courtyards

zh-CN.title: 建筑昼夜漫游
zh-CN.headline: 天坛
zh-CN.introText: 五座建筑，一段从夜到昼的旅程。
zh-CN.smallCopy: 细看每一层屋顶、每一根梁枋和每一级汉白玉台基。
zh-CN.locationNote: 示意性的建筑研究，并非测绘复原
zh-CN.sceneAria: 可交互的三维建筑。拖动旋转所选建筑，滚轮缩放。
zh-CN.note: 拖动模型，找到你自己的视角。
zh-CN.travelHint: 拖动滑块，改变时辰与氛围
zh-CN.hint: 拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放 · 右键拖动平移
zh-CN.hintTouch: 拖动旋转 · 用 + 和 − 缩放

zh-CN.prayer.name: 祈年殿
zh-CN.prayer.tag: 蓝色琉璃 / 彩绘木构
zh-CN.prayer.text: 三重檐攒尖顶、层层斗拱和鎏金宝顶。逐层探索园中的核心建筑。
zh-CN.prayer.detail: 琉璃瓦 · 鎏金檐口 · 彩绘斗拱
zh-CN.imperial-hall.name: 皇乾殿
zh-CN.imperial-hall.text: 层叠的蓝色屋顶立在朱红柱列之上，近景展现彩绘木构的节奏。
zh-CN.imperial-hall.detail: 屋脊 · 朱红立柱 · 彩绘梁枋
zh-CN.vault.name: 皇穹宇
zh-CN.vault.tag: 圆形殿宇 / 鎏金宝顶
zh-CN.vault.text: 一座紧凑的圆形殿宇，被弧形围墙环抱。光线掠过蓝色琉璃瓦和彩绘檐口。
zh-CN.vault.detail: 圆形屋顶 · 彩绘檐口 · 鎏金宝顶
zh-CN.altar.name: 圜丘坛
zh-CN.altar.text: 三层汉白玉台基组成精确的同心圆构图，斜射的日光让雕栏浮现立体感。
zh-CN.altar.detail: 石雕 · 放射台阶 · 同心台基
zh-CN.abstinence.name: 斋宫
zh-CN.abstinence.tag: 绿色琉璃 / 静谧院落
zh-CN.abstinence.text: 绿色琉璃瓦与围合的院落，在祭祀轴线一侧呈现更安静的建筑节奏。
zh-CN.abstinence.detail: 绿色琉璃瓦 · 木构回廊 · 院落
